value.title: Dispatch fence — a worked example
value.issuer: the orchestrator who wrote the brief
value.subject: the delegated coder
value.note: A fence as DATA. Prose fences fail two ways this one cannot: a brief that instructs a mechanism and omits the file it lives in is wrong in a way only a human reviewer catches, and a rule with no recorded cause or expiry outlives its reason with nobody able to say so. Every row here names the owner who may change it, the cause it exists for, and when it stops applying.

value.cause: every change in this phase owes a control
the plan corpus is the orchestrator's to write; a coder editing it would be marking its own homework
value.note: FORBID beats ALLOW, so this holds even though a later allow row is broader.
